description.subtitle: Pack of 3 socks of half adidas cane from Bayern Munich - various colors
description.tagline: Bavarian comfort and pride at every step
description.intro: The 3 half-cane adidas Bayern pack combines comfort, style and the identity of one of the most important clubs in the world. With three designs inspired by Bayern Munich, they are perfect for day to day or to cheer your team with maximum comfort.
key_benefits: Pack of 3 pairs: Different designs to combine with any style.
Soft and elastic fabric: Comfortable and safe fit throughout the day.
Half rod: Comfortable grip with ideal cover.
Official Bayern design: With iconic adidas clover and club-inspired colors.
